content.english: ℣. O Lord, + open thou my lips.

content.latin: ℟. Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
content.english: ℟. And my mouth shall declare thy praise.

segments.t: Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

segments.t: Ant.
Regem ventúrum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino, iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
content.english: Come let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.

content.latin: Ant. Regem ventúrum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. The Lord, the King who is to come * O come, let us adore Him.

segments.t: Ant.
Regem ventúrum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.
content.english: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

content.latin: Ant. Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. O come, let us adore Him.

segments.t: Ant.
Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius (genuflectitur) veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
content.english: For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. (genuflect) Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

segments.t: Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius
(genuflectitur)
veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.

content.latin: Ant. Regem ventúrum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. The Lord, the King who is to come * O come, let us adore Him.

segments.t: Ant.
Regem ventúrum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
content.english: Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.

content.latin: Ant. Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. O come, let us adore Him.

segments.t: Ant.
Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
content.english: Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

content.latin: Verbum supérnum, pródiens
content.english: Celestial Word, to this our earth

content.latin: E Patris ætérni sinu,
content.english: Sent down from God's eternal clime,

content.latin: Qui natus orbi súbvenis,
content.english: To save mankind by mortal birth

content.latin: Labénte cursu témporis:
content.english: Into a world of change and time;

content.latin: Illúmina nunc péctora,
content.english: Enlighten our hearts; vain hopes destroy;

content.latin: Tuóque amóre cóncrema;
content.english: And in thy love's consuming fire

content.latin: Ut cor cadúca déserens
content.english: Fill all the soul with heavenly joy,

content.latin: Cæli volúptas ímpleat.
content.english: And melt the dross of low desire.

content.latin: Ut, cum tribúnal Iúdicis
content.english: So when the Judge of quick and dead

content.latin: Damnábit igni nóxios,
content.english: Shall bid his awful summons come,

content.latin: Et vox amíca débitum
content.english: To whelm the guilty soul with dread,

content.latin: Vocábit ad cælum pios;
content.english: And call the blessed to their home.

content.latin: Non esca flammárum nigros
content.english: Saved from the whirling, black abyss,

content.latin: Volvámur inter túrbines,
content.english: Forevermore to us be given

content.latin: Vultu Dei sed cómpotes
content.english: To share the feast of saintly bliss,

content.latin: Cæli fruámur gáudiis.
content.english: And see the face of God in heaven.

content.latin: Patri, simúlque Fílio,
content.english: To God the Father and the Son

content.latin: Tibíque, Sancte Spíritus,
content.english: Our songs with one accord we raise;

content.latin: Sicut fuit, sit iúgiter
content.english: And to the Holy Spirit, One

content.latin: Sæclum per omne glória.
content.english: With them, be ever equal praise

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ad Nocturnum
content.english: At the Nocturn

segments.t: Ad Nocturnum

content.latin: Ant. Memor fuit in sǽculum * testaménti sui Dóminus Deus noster.
content.english: Ant. The memory of thy testament * will live forever, O Lord our God.

segments.t: Ant.
Memor fuit in sǽculum * testaménti sui Dóminus Deus noster.
Psalmus 104(1-15)

content.latin: 104:1 Confitémini Dómino, et invocáte nomen eius: * annuntiáte inter gentes ópera eius.
content.english: 104:1 Give glory to the Lord, and call upon his name: * declare his deeds among the Gentiles.

segments.t: Confitémini Dómino, et invocáte nomen eius: * annuntiáte inter gentes ópera eius.

content.latin: 104:2 Cantáte ei, et psállite ei: * narráte ómnia mirabília eius.
content.english: 104:2 Sing to him, yea sing praises to him: * relate all his wondrous works.

segments.t: Cantáte ei, et psállite ei: * narráte ómnia mirabília eius.

content.latin: 104:3 Laudámini in nómine sancto eius: * lætétur cor quæréntium Dóminum.
content.english: 104:3 Glory ye in his holy name: * let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

segments.t: Laudámini in nómine sancto eius: * lætétur cor quæréntium Dóminum.

content.latin: 104:4 Quǽrite Dóminum, et confirmámini: * quǽrite fáciem eius semper.
content.english: 104:4 Seek ye the Lord, and be strengthened: * seek his face evermore.

segments.t: Quǽrite Dóminum, et confirmámini: * quǽrite fáciem eius semper.

content.latin: 104:5 Mementóte mirabílium eius, quæ fecit: * prodígia eius, et iudícia oris eius.
content.english: 104:5 Remember his marvellous works which he hath done; * his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth.

segments.t: Mementóte mirabílium eius, quæ fecit: * prodígia eius, et iudícia oris eius.

content.latin: 104:6 Semen Ábraham, servi eius: * fílii Iacob, elécti eius.
content.english: 104:6 O ye seed of Abraham his servant; * ye sons of Jacob his chosen.

segments.t: Semen Ábraham, servi eius: * fílii Iacob, elécti eius.

content.latin: 104:7 Ipse Dóminus Deus noster: * in univérsa terra iudícia eius.
content.english: 104:7 He is the Lord our God: * his judgments are in all the earth.

segments.t: Ipse Dóminus Deus noster: * in univérsa terra iudícia eius.

content.latin: 104:8 Memor fuit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * verbi, quod mandávit in mille generatiónes:
content.english: 104:8 He hath remembered his covenant for ever: * the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

segments.t: Memor fuit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * verbi, quod mandávit in mille generatiónes:

content.latin: 104:9 Quod dispósuit ad Ábraham: * et iuraménti sui ad Isaac:
content.english: 104:9 Which he made to Abraham; * and his oath to Isaac:

segments.t: Quod dispósuit ad Ábraham: * et iuraménti sui ad Isaac:

content.latin: 104:10 Et státuit illud Iacob in præcéptum: * et Israël in testaméntum ætérnum:
content.english: 104:10 And he appointed the same to Jacob for a law, * and to Israel for an everlasting testament:

segments.t: Et státuit illud Iacob in præcéptum: * et Israël in testaméntum ætérnum:

content.latin: 104:11 Dicens: Tibi dabo terram Chánaan, * funículum hereditátis vestræ.
content.english: 104:11 Saying: To thee will I give the land of Chanaan, * the lot of your inheritance.

segments.t: Dicens: Tibi dabo terram Chánaan, * funículum hereditátis vestræ.

content.latin: 104:12 Cum essent número brevi, * paucíssimi et íncolæ eius:
content.english: 104:12 When they were but a small number: * yea very few, and sojourners therein:

segments.t: Cum essent número brevi, * paucíssimi et íncolæ eius:

content.latin: 104:13 Et pertransiérunt de gente in gentem, * et de regno ad pópulum álterum.
content.english: 104:13 And they passed from nation to nation, * and from one kingdom to another people.

segments.t: Et pertransiérunt de gente in gentem, * et de regno ad pópulum álterum.

content.latin: 104:14 Non relíquit hóminem nocére eis: * et corrípuit pro eis reges.
content.english: 104:14 He suffered no man to hurt them: * and he reproved kings for their sakes.

segments.t: Non relíquit hóminem nocére eis: * et corrípuit pro eis reges.

content.latin: 104:15 Nolíte tángere christos meos: * et in prophétis meis nolíte malignári.
content.english: 104:15 Touch ye not my anointed: * and do no evil to my prophets.

segments.t: Nolíte tángere christos meos: * et in prophétis meis nolíte malignári.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Ant. The memory of thy testament will live forever, O Lord our God.

segments.t: Ant.
Memor fuit in sǽculum testaménti sui Dóminus Deus noster.

content.latin: Ant. Auxit Dóminus * pópulum suum: et firmávit eum super inimícos eius.
content.english: Ant. The Lord increased his people exceedingly * and strengthened them over their enemies.

segments.t: Ant.
Auxit Dóminus * pópulum suum: et firmávit eum super inimícos eius.
Psalmus 104(16-27)

content.latin: 104:16 Et vocávit famem super terram: * et omne firmaméntum panis contrívit.
content.english: 104:16 And he called a famine upon the land: * and he broke in pieces all the support of bread.

segments.t: Et vocávit famem super terram: * et omne firmaméntum panis contrívit.

content.latin: 104:17 Misit ante eos virum: * in servum venúmdatus est Ioseph.
content.english: 104:17 He sent a man before them: * Joseph, who was sold for a slave.

segments.t: Misit ante eos virum: * in servum venúmdatus est Ioseph.

content.latin: 104:18 Humiliavérunt in compédibus pedes eius, ferrum pertránsiit ánimam eius * donec veníret verbum eius.
content.english: 104:18 They humbled his feet in fetters: the iron pierced his soul, * until his word came.

segments.t: Humiliavérunt in compédibus pedes eius, ferrum pertránsiit ánimam eius * donec veníret verbum eius.

content.latin: 104:19 Elóquium Dómini inflammávit eum: * misit rex, et solvit eum; princeps populórum, et dimísit eum.
content.english: 104:19 The word of the Lord inflamed him: * the king sent, and he released him: the ruler of the people, and he set him at liberty.

segments.t: Elóquium Dómini inflammávit eum: * misit rex, et solvit eum; princeps populórum, et dimísit eum.

content.latin: 104:21 Constítuit eum dóminum domus suæ: * et príncipem omnis possessiónis suæ:
content.english: 104:21 He made him master of his house, * and ruler of all his possession.

segments.t: Constítuit eum dóminum domus suæ: * et príncipem omnis possessiónis suæ:

content.latin: 104:22 Ut erudíret príncipes eius sicut semetípsum: * et senes eius prudéntiam docéret.
content.english: 104:22 That he might instruct his princes as himself, * and teach his ancients wisdom.

segments.t: Ut erudíret príncipes eius sicut semetípsum: * et senes eius prudéntiam docéret.

content.latin: 104:23 Et intrávit Israël in Ægýptum: * et Iacob áccola fuit in terra Cham.
content.english: 104:23 And Israel went into Egypt: * and Jacob was a sojourner in the land of Cham.

segments.t: Et intrávit Israël in Ægýptum: * et Iacob áccola fuit in terra Cham.

content.latin: 104:24 Et auxit pópulum suum veheménter: * et firmávit eum super inimícos eius.
content.english: 104:24 And he increased his people exceedingly: * and strengthened them over their enemies,

segments.t: Et auxit pópulum suum veheménter: * et firmávit eum super inimícos eius.

content.latin: 104:25 Convértit cor eórum ut odírent pópulum eius: * et dolum fácerent in servos eius.
content.english: 104:25 He turned their heart to hate his people: * and to deal deceitfully with his servants.

segments.t: Convértit cor eórum ut odírent pópulum eius: * et dolum fácerent in servos eius.

content.latin: 104:26 Misit Móysen, servum suum: * Aaron, quem elégit ipsum.
content.english: 104:26 He sent Moses his servant: * Aaron the man whom he had chosen.

segments.t: Misit Móysen, servum suum: * Aaron, quem elégit ipsum.

content.latin: 104:27 Pósuit in eis verba signórum suórum: * et prodigiórum in terra Cham.
content.english: 104:27 He gave them power to shew his signs, * and his wonders in the land of Cham.

segments.t: Pósuit in eis verba signórum suórum: * et prodigiórum in terra Cham.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Auxit Dóminus pópulum suum: et firmávit eum super inimícos eius.
content.english: Ant. The Lord increased his people exceedingly and strengthened them over their enemies.

segments.t: Ant.
Auxit Dóminus pópulum suum: et firmávit eum super inimícos eius.

content.latin: Ant. Edúxit Deus * pópulum suum in exsultatióne, et eléctos suos in lætítia.
content.english: Ant. The Lord brought forth * his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness.

segments.t: Ant.
Edúxit Deus * pópulum suum in exsultatióne, et eléctos suos in lætítia.
Psalmus 104(28-45)

content.latin: 104:28 Misit ténebras, et obscurávit: * et non exacerbávit sermónes suos.
content.english: 104:28 He sent darkness, and made it obscure: * and grieved not his words.

segments.t: Misit ténebras, et obscurávit: * et non exacerbávit sermónes suos.

content.latin: 104:29 Convértit aquas eórum in sánguinem: * et occídit pisces eórum.
content.english: 104:29 He turned their waters into blood, * and destroyed their fish.

segments.t: Convértit aquas eórum in sánguinem: * et occídit pisces eórum.

content.latin: 104:30 Édidit terra eórum ranas: * in penetrálibus regum ipsórum.
content.english: 104:30 Their land brought forth frogs, * in the inner chambers of their kings.

segments.t: Édidit terra eórum ranas: * in penetrálibus regum ipsórum.

content.latin: 104:31 Dixit, et venit cœnomyía: * et cínifes in ómnibus fínibus eórum.
content.english: 104:31 He spoke, and there came diverse sorts of flies, * and sciniphs in all their coasts.

segments.t: Dixit, et venit cœnomyía: * et cínifes in ómnibus fínibus eórum.

content.latin: 104:32 Pósuit plúvias eórum grándinem: * ignem comburéntem in terra ipsórum.
content.english: 104:32 He gave them hail for rain, * a burning fire in the land.

segments.t: Pósuit plúvias eórum grándinem: * ignem comburéntem in terra ipsórum.

content.latin: 104:33 Et percússit víneas eórum, et ficúlneas eórum: * et contrívit lignum fínium eórum.
content.english: 104:33 And he destroyed their vineyards, and their fig trees: * and he broke in pieces the trees of their coasts.

segments.t: Et percússit víneas eórum, et ficúlneas eórum: * et contrívit lignum fínium eórum.

content.latin: 104:34 Dixit, et venit locústa, et bruchus, * cuius non erat númerus:
content.english: 104:34 He spoke, and the locust came, and the bruchus, * of which there was no number.

segments.t: Dixit, et venit locústa, et bruchus, * cuius non erat númerus:

content.latin: 104:35 Et comédit omne fænum in terra eórum: * et comédit omnem fructum terræ eórum.
content.english: 104:35 And they devoured all the grass in their land, * and consumed all the fruit of their ground.

segments.t: Et comédit omne fænum in terra eórum: * et comédit omnem fructum terræ eórum.

content.latin: 104:36 Et percússit omne primogénitum in terra eórum: * primítias omnis labóris eórum.
content.english: 104:36 And he slew all the firstborn in their land: * the firstfruits of all their labour.

segments.t: Et percússit omne primogénitum in terra eórum: * primítias omnis labóris eórum.

content.latin: 104:37 Et edúxit eos cum argénto et auro: * et non erat in tríbubus eórum infírmus.
content.english: 104:37 And he brought them out with silver and gold: * and there was not among their tribes one that was feeble.

segments.t: Et edúxit eos cum argénto et auro: * et non erat in tríbubus eórum infírmus.

content.latin: 104:38 Lætáta est Ægýptus in profectióne eórum: * quia incúbuit timor eórum super eos.
content.english: 104:38 Egypt was glad when they departed: * for the fear of them lay upon them.

segments.t: Lætáta est Ægýptus in profectióne eórum: * quia incúbuit timor eórum super eos.

content.latin: 104:39 Expándit nubem in protectiónem eórum: * et ignem ut lucéret eis per noctem.
content.english: 104:39 He spread a cloud for their protection, * and fire to give them light in the night.

segments.t: Expándit nubem in protectiónem eórum: * et ignem ut lucéret eis per noctem.

content.latin: 104:40 Petiérunt, et venit cotúrnix: * et pane cæli saturávit eos.
content.english: 104:40 They asked, and the quail came: * and he filled them with the bread of heaven.

segments.t: Petiérunt, et venit cotúrnix: * et pane cæli saturávit eos.

content.latin: 104:41 Dirúpit petram et fluxérunt aquæ: * abiérunt in sicco flúmina;
content.english: 104:41 He opened the rock, and waters flowed: * rivers ran down in the dry land.

segments.t: Dirúpit petram et fluxérunt aquæ: * abiérunt in sicco flúmina;

content.latin: 104:42 Quóniam memor fuit verbi sancti sui: * quod hábuit ad Ábraham, púerum suum.
content.english: 104:42 Because he remembered his holy word, * which he had spoken to his servant Abraham.

segments.t: Quóniam memor fuit verbi sancti sui: * quod hábuit ad Ábraham, púerum suum.

content.latin: 104:43 Et edúxit pópulum suum in exsultatióne, * et eléctos suos in lætítia.
content.english: 104:43 And he brought forth his people with joy, * and his chosen with gladness.

segments.t: Et edúxit pópulum suum in exsultatióne, * et eléctos suos in lætítia.

content.latin: 104:44 Et dedit illis regiónes géntium: * et labóres populórum possedérunt:
content.english: 104:44 And he gave them the lands of the Gentiles: * and they possessed the labours of the people:

segments.t: Et dedit illis regiónes géntium: * et labóres populórum possedérunt:

content.latin: 104:45 Ut custódiant iustificatiónes eius, * et legem eius requírant.
content.english: 104:45 That they might observe his justifications, * and seek after his law.

segments.t: Ut custódiant iustificatiónes eius, * et legem eius requírant.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Ant. The Lord brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness.

Edúxit Deus pópulum suum in exsultatióne, et eléctos suos in lætítia.

content.english: Ant. The Lord saved them * for his own name's sake.

segments.t: Ant.
Salvávit eos Dóminus * propter nomen suum.
Psalmus 105(1-15)

content.latin: 105:1 Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.
content.english: 105:1 Give glory to the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

segments.t: Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.

content.latin: 105:2 Quis loquétur poténtias Dómini, * audítas fáciet omnes laudes eius?
content.english: 105:2 Who shall declare the powers of the Lord? * who shall set forth all his praises?

segments.t: Quis loquétur poténtias Dómini, * audítas fáciet omnes laudes eius?

content.latin: 105:3 Beáti, qui custódiunt iudícium, * et fáciunt iustítiam in omni témpore.
content.english: 105:3 Blessed are they that keep judgment, * and do justice at all times.

segments.t: Beáti, qui custódiunt iudícium, * et fáciunt iustítiam in omni témpore.

content.latin: 105:4 Meménto nostri, Dómine, in beneplácito pópuli tui: * vísita nos in salutári tuo:
content.english: 105:4 Remember us, O Lord, in the favour of thy people: * visit us with thy salvation.

segments.t: Meménto nostri, Dómine, in beneplácito pópuli tui: * vísita nos in salutári tuo:

content.latin: 105:5 Ad vidéndum in bonitáte electórum tuórum, ad lætándum in lætítia gentis tuæ: * ut laudéris cum hereditáte tua.
content.english: 105:5 That we may see the good of thy chosen, that we may rejoice in the joy of thy nation: * that thou mayst be praised with thy inheritance.

segments.t: Ad vidéndum in bonitáte electórum tuórum, ad lætándum in lætítia gentis tuæ: * ut laudéris cum hereditáte tua.

content.latin: 105:6 Peccávimus cum pátribus nostris: * iniúste égimus, iniquitátem fécimus.
content.english: 105:6 We have sinned with our fathers: * we have acted unjustly, we have wrought iniquity.

segments.t: Peccávimus cum pátribus nostris: * iniúste égimus, iniquitátem fécimus.

content.latin: 105:7 Patres nostri in Ægýpto non intellexérunt mirabília tua: * non fuérunt mémores multitúdinis misericórdiæ tuæ.
content.english: 105:7 Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt: * they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies:

segments.t: Patres nostri in Ægýpto non intellexérunt mirabília tua: * non fuérunt mémores multitúdinis misericórdiæ tuæ.

content.latin: 105:7 Et irritavérunt ascendéntes in mare, * Mare Rubrum.
content.english: 105:7 And they provoked to wrath going up to the sea, * even the Red Sea.

segments.t: Et irritavérunt ascendéntes in mare, * Mare Rubrum.

content.latin: 105:8 Et salvávit eos propter nomen suum: * ut notam fáceret poténtiam suam.
content.english: 105:8 And he saved them for his own name’s sake: * that he might make his power known.

segments.t: Et salvávit eos propter nomen suum: * ut notam fáceret poténtiam suam.

content.latin: 105:9 Et incrépuit Mare Rubrum, et exsiccátum est, * et dedúxit eos in abýssis sicut in desérto.
content.english: 105:9 And he rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up: * and he led them through the depths, as in a wilderness.

segments.t: Et incrépuit Mare Rubrum, et exsiccátum est, * et dedúxit eos in abýssis sicut in desérto.

content.latin: 105:10 Et salvávit eos de manu odiéntium: * et redémit eos de manu inimíci.
content.english: 105:10 And he saved them from the hand of them that hated them: * and he redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

segments.t: Et salvávit eos de manu odiéntium: * et redémit eos de manu inimíci.

content.latin: 105:11 Et opéruit aqua tribulántes eos: * unus ex eis non remánsit.
content.english: 105:11 And the water covered them that afflicted them: * there was not one of them left.

segments.t: Et opéruit aqua tribulántes eos: * unus ex eis non remánsit.

content.latin: 105:12 Et credidérunt verbis eius: * et laudavérunt laudem eius.
content.english: 105:12 And they believed his words: * and they sang his praises.

segments.t: Et credidérunt verbis eius: * et laudavérunt laudem eius.

content.latin: 105:13 Cito fecérunt, oblíti sunt óperum eius: * et non sustinuérunt consílium eius.
content.english: 105:13 They had quickly done, they forgot his works: * and they waited not for his counsels.

segments.t: Cito fecérunt, oblíti sunt óperum eius: * et non sustinuérunt consílium eius.

content.latin: 105:14 Et concupiérunt concupiscéntiam in desérto: * et tentavérunt Deum in inaquóso.
content.english: 105:14 And they coveted their desire in the desert: * and they tempted God in the place without water.

segments.t: Et concupiérunt concupiscéntiam in desérto: * et tentavérunt Deum in inaquóso.

content.latin: 105:15 Et dedit eis petitiónem ipsórum: * et misit saturitátem in ánimas eórum.
content.english: 105:15 And he gave them their request: * and sent fulness into their souls.

segments.t: Et dedit eis petitiónem ipsórum: * et misit saturitátem in ánimas eórum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
