content.english: Ant. The Lord saved them for his own name's sake.

segments.t: Ant.
Salvávit eos Dóminus propter nomen suum.

content.latin: Ant. Oblíti sunt Deum * qui salvávit eos.
content.english: Ant. They forgot God * who saved them.

segments.t: Ant.
Oblíti sunt Deum * qui salvávit eos.
Psalmus 105(16-31)

content.latin: 105:16 Et irritavérunt Móysen in castris: * Aaron, sanctum Dómini.
content.english: 105:16 And they provoked Moses in the camp, * Aaron the holy one of the Lord.

segments.t: Et irritavérunt Móysen in castris: * Aaron, sanctum Dómini.

content.latin: 105:17 Apérta est terra, et deglutívit Dathan: * et opéruit super congregatiónem Abíron.
content.english: 105:17 The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan: * and covered the congregation of Abiron.

segments.t: Apérta est terra, et deglutívit Dathan: * et opéruit super congregatiónem Abíron.

content.latin: 105:18 Et exársit ignis in synagóga eórum * flamma combússit peccatóres.
content.english: 105:18 And a fire was kindled in their congregation: * the flame burned the wicked.

segments.t: Et exársit ignis in synagóga eórum * flamma combússit peccatóres.

content.latin: 105:19 Et fecérunt vítulum in Horeb * et adoravérunt scúlptile.
content.english: 105:19 They made also a calf in Horeb: * and they adored the graven thing.

segments.t: Et fecérunt vítulum in Horeb * et adoravérunt scúlptile.

content.latin: 105:20 Et mutavérunt glóriam suam * in similitúdinem vítuli comedéntis fænum.
content.english: 105:20 And they changed their glory * into the likeness of a calf that eateth grass.

segments.t: Et mutavérunt glóriam suam * in similitúdinem vítuli comedéntis fænum.

content.latin: 105:21 Oblíti sunt Deum, qui salvávit eos, * qui fecit magnália in Ægýpto, mirabília in terra Cham: terribília in Mari Rubro.
content.english: 105:21 They forgot God, who saved them, * who had done great things in Egypt, wondrous works in the land of Cham: terrible things in the Red Sea.

segments.t: Oblíti sunt Deum, qui salvávit eos, * qui fecit magnália in Ægýpto, mirabília in terra Cham: terribília in Mari Rubro.

content.latin: 105:23 Et dixit ut dispérderet eos: * si non Móyses, eléctus eius, stetísset in confractióne in conspéctu eius:
content.english: 105:23 And he said that he would destroy them: * had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach:

segments.t: Et dixit ut dispérderet eos: * si non Móyses, eléctus eius, stetísset in confractióne in conspéctu eius:

content.latin: 105:24 Ut avérteret iram eius ne dispérderet eos: * et pro níhilo habuérunt terram desiderábilem:
content.english: 105:24 To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them; * and they set at nought the desirable land.

segments.t: Ut avérteret iram eius ne dispérderet eos: * et pro níhilo habuérunt terram desiderábilem:

content.latin: 105:25 Non credidérunt verbo eius, et murmuravérunt in tabernáculis suis: * non exaudiérunt vocem Dómini.
content.english: 105:25 They believed not his word, and they murmured in their tents: * they hearkened not to the voice of the Lord.

segments.t: Non credidérunt verbo eius, et murmuravérunt in tabernáculis suis: * non exaudiérunt vocem Dómini.

content.latin: 105:26 Et elevávit manum suam super eos: * ut prostérneret eos in desérto:
content.english: 105:26 And he lifted up his hand over them: * to overthrow them in the desert;

segments.t: Et elevávit manum suam super eos: * ut prostérneret eos in desérto:

content.latin: 105:27 Et ut deíceret semen eórum in natiónibus: * et dispérgeret eos in regiónibus.
content.english: 105:27 And to cast down their seed among the nations, * and to scatter them in the countries.

segments.t: Et ut deíceret semen eórum in natiónibus: * et dispérgeret eos in regiónibus.

content.latin: 105:28 Et initiáti sunt Beélphegor: * et comedérunt sacrifícia mortuórum.
content.english: 105:28 They also were initiated to Beelphegor: * and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

segments.t: Et initiáti sunt Beélphegor: * et comedérunt sacrifícia mortuórum.

content.latin: 105:29 Et irritavérunt eum in adinventiónibus suis: * et multiplicáta est in eis ruína.
content.english: 105:29 And they provoked him with their inventions: * and destruction was multiplied among them.

segments.t: Et irritavérunt eum in adinventiónibus suis: * et multiplicáta est in eis ruína.

content.latin: 105:30 Et stetit Phínees, et placávit: * et cessávit quassátio.
content.english: 105:30 Then Phinees stood up, and pacified him: * and the slaughter ceased.

segments.t: Et stetit Phínees, et placávit: * et cessávit quassátio.

content.latin: 105:31 Et reputátum est ei in iustítiam: * in generatiónem et generatiónem usque in sempitérnum.
content.english: 105:31 And it was reputed to him unto justice, * to generation and generation for evermore.

segments.t: Et reputátum est ei in iustítiam: * in generatiónem et generatiónem usque in sempitérnum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Oblíti sunt Deum qui salvávit eos.
content.english: Ant. They forgot God who saved them.

segments.t: Ant.
Oblíti sunt Deum qui salvávit eos.

content.latin: Ant. Cum tribularéntur * vidit Dóminus: et audívit oratiónem eórum.
content.english: Ant. And he saw when they were in tribulation * and he heard their prayer.

segments.t: Ant.
Cum tribularéntur * vidit Dóminus: et audívit oratiónem eórum.
Psalmus 105(32-48)

content.latin: 105:32 Et irritavérunt eum ad aquas contradictiónis: * et vexátus est Móyses propter eos: quia exacerbavérunt spíritum eius.
content.english: 105:32 They provoked him also at the waters of contradiction: * and Moses was afflicted for their sakes: because they exasperated his spirit.

segments.t: Et irritavérunt eum ad aquas contradictiónis: * et vexátus est Móyses propter eos: quia exacerbavérunt spíritum eius.

content.latin: 105:33 Et distínxit in lábiis suis: * non disperdidérunt gentes, quas dixit Dóminus illis.
content.english: 105:33 And he distinguished with his lips; * they did not destroy the nations of which the Lord spoke unto them.

segments.t: Et distínxit in lábiis suis: * non disperdidérunt gentes, quas dixit Dóminus illis.

content.latin: 105:35 Et commísti sunt inter gentes, et didicérunt ópera eórum: et serviérunt sculptílibus eórum: * et factum est illis in scándalum.
content.english: 105:35 And they were mingled among the heathens, and learned their works: and served their idols, * and it became a stumblingblock to them.

segments.t: Et commísti sunt inter gentes, et didicérunt ópera eórum: et serviérunt sculptílibus eórum: * et factum est illis in scándalum.

content.latin: 105:37 Et immolavérunt fílios suos, * et fílias suas dæmóniis.
content.english: 105:37 And they sacrificed their sons, * and their daughters to devils.

segments.t: Et immolavérunt fílios suos, * et fílias suas dæmóniis.

content.latin: 105:38 Et effudérunt sánguinem innocéntem: * sánguinem filiórum suórum et filiárum suárum, quas sacrificavérunt sculptílibus Chánaan.
content.english: 105:38 And they shed innocent blood: * the blood of their sons and of their daughters which they sacrificed to the idols of Chanaan.

segments.t: Et effudérunt sánguinem innocéntem: * sánguinem filiórum suórum et filiárum suárum, quas sacrificavérunt sculptílibus Chánaan.

content.latin: 105:39 Et infécta est terra in sanguínibus, et contamináta est in opéribus eórum: * et fornicáti sunt in adinventiónibus suis.
content.english: 105:39 And the land was polluted with blood, and was defiled with their works: * and they went aside after their own inventions.

segments.t: Et infécta est terra in sanguínibus, et contamináta est in opéribus eórum: * et fornicáti sunt in adinventiónibus suis.

content.latin: 105:40 Et irátus est furóre Dóminus in pópulum suum: * et abominátus est hereditátem suam.
content.english: 105:40 And the Lord was exceedingly angry with his people: * and he abhorred his inheritance.

segments.t: Et irátus est furóre Dóminus in pópulum suum: * et abominátus est hereditátem suam.

content.latin: 105:41 Et trádidit eos in manus géntium: * et domináti sunt eórum qui odérunt eos.
content.english: 105:41 And he delivered them into the hands of the nations: * and they that hated them had dominion over them.

segments.t: Et trádidit eos in manus géntium: * et domináti sunt eórum qui odérunt eos.

content.latin: 105:42 Et tribulavérunt eos inimíci eórum, et humiliáti sunt sub mánibus eórum: * sæpe liberávit eos.
content.english: 105:42 And their enemies afflicted them: and they were humbled under their hands: * many times did he deliver them.

segments.t: Et tribulavérunt eos inimíci eórum, et humiliáti sunt sub mánibus eórum: * sæpe liberávit eos.

content.latin: 105:43 Ipsi autem exacerbavérunt eum in consílio suo: * et humiliáti sunt in iniquitátibus suis.
content.english: 105:43 But they provoked him with their counsel: * and they were brought low by their iniquities.

segments.t: Ipsi autem exacerbavérunt eum in consílio suo: * et humiliáti sunt in iniquitátibus suis.

content.latin: 105:44 Et vidit, cum tribularéntur: * et audívit oratiónem eórum.
content.english: 105:44 And he saw when they were in tribulation: * and he heard their prayer.

segments.t: Et vidit, cum tribularéntur: * et audívit oratiónem eórum.

content.latin: 105:45 Et memor fuit testaménti sui: * et pœnítuit eum secúndum multitúdinem misericórdiæ suæ.
content.english: 105:45 And he was mindful of his covenant: * and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

segments.t: Et memor fuit testaménti sui: * et pœnítuit eum secúndum multitúdinem misericórdiæ suæ.

content.latin: 105:46 Et dedit eos in misericórdias * in conspéctu ómnium qui céperant eos.
content.english: 105:46 And he gave them unto mercies, * in the sight of all those that had made them captives.

segments.t: Et dedit eos in misericórdias * in conspéctu ómnium qui céperant eos.

content.latin: 105:47 Salvos nos fac, Dómine, Deus noster: * et cóngrega nos de natiónibus:
content.english: 105:47 Save us, O Lord, our God: * and gather us from among nations:

segments.t: Salvos nos fac, Dómine, Deus noster: * et cóngrega nos de natiónibus:

content.latin: 105:47 Ut confiteámur nómini sancto tuo: * et gloriémur in laude tua.
content.english: 105:47 That we may give thanks to thy holy name, * and may glory in thy praise.

segments.t: Ut confiteámur nómini sancto tuo: * et gloriémur in laude tua.

content.latin: 105:48 Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum: * et dicet omnis pópulus: Fiat, fiat.
content.english: 105:48 Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting: * and let all the people say: So be it, so be it.

segments.t: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum: * et dicet omnis pópulus: Fiat, fiat.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Cum tribularéntur vidit Dóminus: et audívit oratiónem eórum.
content.english: Ant. And he saw when they were in tribulation and he heard their prayer.

segments.t: Ant.
Cum tribularéntur vidit Dóminus: et audívit oratiónem eórum.

content.latin: Ant. Clamavérunt ad Dóminum * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
content.english: Ant. Then they cried to the Lord * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

segments.t: Ant.
Clamavérunt ad Dóminum * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
Psalmus 106(1-14)

content.latin: 106:1 Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.
content.english: 106:1 Give glory to the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

segments.t: Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.

content.latin: 106:2 Dicant qui redémpti sunt a Dómino, quos redémit de manu inimíci: * et de regiónibus congregávit eos:
content.english: 106:2 Let them say so that have been redeemed by the Lord, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy: * and gathered out of the countries.

segments.t: Dicant qui redémpti sunt a Dómino, quos redémit de manu inimíci: * et de regiónibus congregávit eos:

content.latin: 106:3 A solis ortu, et occásu: * ab aquilóne, et mari.
content.english: 106:3 From the rising and the setting of the sun, * from the north and from the sea.

segments.t: A solis ortu, et occásu: * ab aquilóne, et mari.

content.latin: 106:4 Erravérunt in solitúdine in inaquóso: * viam civitátis habitáculi non invenérunt.
content.english: 106:4 They wandered in a wilderness, in a place without water: * they found not the way of a city for their habitation.

segments.t: Erravérunt in solitúdine in inaquóso: * viam civitátis habitáculi non invenérunt.

content.latin: 106:5 Esuriéntes, et sitiéntes: * ánima eórum in ipsis defécit.
content.english: 106:5 They were hungry and thirsty: * their soul fainted in them.

segments.t: Esuriéntes, et sitiéntes: * ánima eórum in ipsis defécit.

content.latin: 106:6 Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum erípuit eos.
content.english: 106:6 And they cried to the Lord in their tribulation: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

segments.t: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum erípuit eos.

content.latin: 106:7 Et dedúxit eos in viam rectam: * ut irent in civitátem habitatiónis.
content.english: 106:7 And he led them into the right way: * that they might go to a city of habitation.

segments.t: Et dedúxit eos in viam rectam: * ut irent in civitátem habitatiónis.

content.latin: 106:8 Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.
content.english: 106:8 Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him: * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

segments.t: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.

content.latin: 106:9 Quia satiávit ánimam inánem: * et ánimam esuriéntem satiávit bonis.
content.english: 106:9 For he hath satisfied the empty soul, * and hath filled the hungry soul with good things.

segments.t: Quia satiávit ánimam inánem: * et ánimam esuriéntem satiávit bonis.

content.latin: 106:10 Sedéntes in ténebris, et umbra mortis: * vinctos in mendicitáte et ferro.
content.english: 106:10 Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death: * bound in want and in iron.

segments.t: Sedéntes in ténebris, et umbra mortis: * vinctos in mendicitáte et ferro.

content.latin: 106:11 Quia exacerbavérunt elóquia Dei: * et consílium Altíssimi irritavérunt.
content.english: 106:11 Because they had exasperated the words of God: * and provoked the counsel of the most High:

segments.t: Quia exacerbavérunt elóquia Dei: * et consílium Altíssimi irritavérunt.

content.latin: 106:12 Et humiliátum est in labóribus cor eórum: * infirmáti sunt, nec fuit qui adiuváret.
content.english: 106:12 And their heart was humbled with labours: * they were weakened, and there was none to help them.

segments.t: Et humiliátum est in labóribus cor eórum: * infirmáti sunt, nec fuit qui adiuváret.

content.latin: 106:13 Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
content.english: 106:13 Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

segments.t: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.

content.latin: 106:14 Et edúxit eos de ténebris, et umbra mortis: * et víncula eórum disrúpit.
content.english: 106:14 And he brought them out of darkness, * and the shadow of death; and broke their bonds in sunder.

segments.t: Et edúxit eos de ténebris, et umbra mortis: * et víncula eórum disrúpit.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Clamavérunt ad Dóminum et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
content.english: Ant. Then they cried to the Lord and he delivered them out of their distresses.

segments.t: Ant.
Clamavérunt ad Dóminum et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.

content.latin: Ant. Ipsi vidérunt * ópera Dei et mirabília eius.
content.english: Ant. These have seen * the works of the Lord, and his wonders.

segments.t: Ant.
Ipsi vidérunt * ópera Dei et mirabília eius.
Psalmus 106(15-30)

content.latin: 106:15 Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.
content.english: 106:15 Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him, * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

segments.t: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.

content.latin: 106:16 Quia contrívit portas ǽreas: * et vectes férreos confrégit.
content.english: 106:16 Because he hath broken gates of brass, * and burst the iron bars.

segments.t: Quia contrívit portas ǽreas: * et vectes férreos confrégit.

content.latin: 106:17 Suscépit eos de via iniquitátis eórum: * propter iniustítias enim suas humiliáti sunt.
content.english: 106:17 He took them out of the way of their iniquity: * for they were brought low for their injustices.

segments.t: Suscépit eos de via iniquitátis eórum: * propter iniustítias enim suas humiliáti sunt.

content.latin: 106:18 Omnem escam abomináta est ánima eórum: * et appropinquavérunt usque ad portas mortis.
content.english: 106:18 Their soul abhorred all manner of meat: * and they drew nigh even to the gates of death.

segments.t: Omnem escam abomináta est ánima eórum: * et appropinquavérunt usque ad portas mortis.

content.latin: 106:19 Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
content.english: 106:19 And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

segments.t: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.

content.latin: 106:20 Misit verbum suum, et sanávit eos: * et erípuit eos de interitiónibus eórum.
content.english: 106:20 He sent his word, and healed them: * and delivered them from their destructions.

segments.t: Misit verbum suum, et sanávit eos: * et erípuit eos de interitiónibus eórum.

content.latin: 106:21 Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.
content.english: 106:21 Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him: * and his wonderful works to the children of men

segments.t: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.

content.latin: 106:22 Et sacríficent sacrifícium laudis: * et annúntient ópera eius in exsultatióne.
content.english: 106:22 And let them sacrifice the sacrifice of praise: * and declare his works with joy.

segments.t: Et sacríficent sacrifícium laudis: * et annúntient ópera eius in exsultatióne.

content.latin: 106:23 Qui descéndunt mare in návibus, * faciéntes operatiónem in aquis multis.
content.english: 106:23 They that go down to the sea in ships, * doing business in the great waters:

segments.t: Qui descéndunt mare in návibus, * faciéntes operatiónem in aquis multis.

content.latin: 106:24 Ipsi vidérunt ópera Dómini, * et mirabília eius in profúndo.
content.english: 106:24 These have seen the works of the Lord, * and his wonders in the deep.

segments.t: Ipsi vidérunt ópera Dómini, * et mirabília eius in profúndo.

content.latin: 106:25 Dixit, et stetit spíritus procéllæ: * et exaltáti sunt fluctus eius.
content.english: 106:25 He said the word, and there arose a storm of wind: * and the waves thereof were lifted up.

segments.t: Dixit, et stetit spíritus procéllæ: * et exaltáti sunt fluctus eius.

content.latin: 106:26 Ascéndunt usque ad cælos, et descéndunt usque ad abýssos: * ánima eórum in malis tabescébat.
content.english: 106:26 They mount up to the heavens, and they go down to the depths: * their soul pined away with evils.

segments.t: Ascéndunt usque ad cælos, et descéndunt usque ad abýssos: * ánima eórum in malis tabescébat.

content.latin: 106:27 Turbáti sunt, et moti sunt sicut ébrius: * et omnis sapiéntia eórum devoráta est.
content.english: 106:27 They were troubled, and reeled like a drunken man; * and all their wisdom was swallowed up.

segments.t: Turbáti sunt, et moti sunt sicut ébrius: * et omnis sapiéntia eórum devoráta est.

content.latin: 106:28 Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum edúxit eos.
content.english: 106:28 And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he brought them out of their distresses.

segments.t: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum edúxit eos.

content.latin: 106:29 Et státuit procéllam eius in auram: * et siluérunt fluctus eius.
content.english: 106:29 And he turned the storm into a breeze: * and its waves were still.

segments.t: Et státuit procéllam eius in auram: * et siluérunt fluctus eius.

content.latin: 106:30 Et lætáti sunt quia siluérunt: * et dedúxit eos in portum voluntátis eórum.
content.english: 106:30 And they rejoiced because they were still: * and he brought them to the haven which they wished for.

segments.t: Et lætáti sunt quia siluérunt: * et dedúxit eos in portum voluntátis eórum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Ipsi vidérunt ópera Dei et mirabília eius.
content.english: Ant. These have seen the works of the Lord, and his wonders.

segments.t: Ant.
Ipsi vidérunt ópera Dei et mirabília eius.

content.latin: Ant. Vidébunt recti * et lætabúntur, et intéllegent misericórdias Dómini.
content.english: Ant. The just see and rejoice * and understand the mercy of the Lord.

segments.t: Ant.
Vidébunt recti * et lætabúntur, et intéllegent misericórdias Dómini.
Psalmus 106(31-43)

content.latin: 106:31 Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.
content.english: 106:31 Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him, * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

segments.t: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.

content.latin: 106:32 Et exáltent eum in ecclésia plebis: * et in cáthedra seniórum laudent eum.
content.english: 106:32 And let them exalt him in the church of the people: * and praise him in the chair of the ancients.

segments.t: Et exáltent eum in ecclésia plebis: * et in cáthedra seniórum laudent eum.

content.latin: 106:33 Pósuit flúmina in desértum: * et éxitus aquárum in sitim.
content.english: 106:33 He hath turned rivers into a wilderness: * and the sources of water into dry ground:

segments.t: Pósuit flúmina in desértum: * et éxitus aquárum in sitim.

content.latin: 106:34 Terram fructíferam in salsúginem: * a malítia inhabitántium in ea.
content.english: 106:34 A fruitful land into barrenness, * for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

segments.t: Terram fructíferam in salsúginem: * a malítia inhabitántium in ea.

content.latin: 106:35 Pósuit desértum in stagna aquárum: * et terram sine aqua in éxitus aquárum.
content.english: 106:35 He hath turned a wilderness into pools of water, * and a dry land into water springs.

segments.t: Pósuit desértum in stagna aquárum: * et terram sine aqua in éxitus aquárum.

content.latin: 106:36 Et collocávit illic esuriéntes: * et constituérunt civitátem habitatiónis.
content.english: 106:36 And hath placed there the hungry; * and they made a city for their habitation.

segments.t: Et collocávit illic esuriéntes: * et constituérunt civitátem habitatiónis.

content.latin: 106:37 Et seminavérunt agros, et plantavérunt víneas: * et fecérunt fructum nativitátis.
content.english: 106:37 And they sowed fields, and planted vineyards: * and they yielded fruit of birth.

segments.t: Et seminavérunt agros, et plantavérunt víneas: * et fecérunt fructum nativitátis.

content.latin: 106:38 Et benedíxit eis, et multiplicáti sunt nimis: * et iuménta eórum non minorávit.
content.english: 106:38 And he blessed them, and they were multiplied exceedingly: * and their cattle he suffered not to decrease.

segments.t: Et benedíxit eis, et multiplicáti sunt nimis: * et iuménta eórum non minorávit.

content.latin: 106:39 Et pauci facti sunt: * et vexáti sunt a tribulatióne malórum, et dolóre.
content.english: 106:39 Then they were brought to be few: * and they were afflicted through the trouble of evils and sorrow.

segments.t: Et pauci facti sunt: * et vexáti sunt a tribulatióne malórum, et dolóre.

content.latin: 106:40 Effúsa est contémptio super príncipes: * et erráre fecit eos in ínvio, et non in via.
content.english: 106:40 Contempt was poured forth upon their princes: *and he caused them to wander where there was no passing, and out of the way.

segments.t: Effúsa est contémptio super príncipes: * et erráre fecit eos in ínvio, et non in via.

content.latin: 106:41 Et adiúvit páuperem de inópia: * et pósuit sicut oves famílias.
content.english: 106:41 And he helped the poor out of poverty: * and made him families like a flock of sheep.

segments.t: Et adiúvit páuperem de inópia: * et pósuit sicut oves famílias.

content.latin: 106:42 Vidébunt recti, et lætabúntur: * et omnis iníquitas oppilábit os suum.
content.english: 106:42 The just shall see, and shall rejoice, * and all iniquity shall stop their mouth.

segments.t: Vidébunt recti, et lætabúntur: * et omnis iníquitas oppilábit os suum.

content.latin: 106:43 Quis sápiens et custódiet hæc? * et intélleget misericórdias Dómini.
content.english: 106:43 Who is wise, and will keep these things: * and will understand the mercies of the Lord?

segments.t: Quis sápiens et custódiet hæc? * et intélleget misericórdias Dómini.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Vidébunt recti et lætabúntur, et intéllegent misericórdias Dómini.
content.english: Ant. The just see and rejoice and understand the mercy of the Lord.

segments.t: Ant.
Vidébunt recti et lætabúntur, et intéllegent misericórdias Dómini.

content.latin: ℣. Egrediétur Dóminus de loco sancto suo.
content.english: ℣. The Lord will come out of his place.

segments.t: Egrediétur Dóminus de loco sancto suo.

content.latin: ℟. Véniet ut salvet pópulum suum.
content.english: ℟. He comes to save his people.

segments.t: Véniet ut salvet pópulum suum.

content.latin: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
content.english: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

segments.t: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris:
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.

content.latin: ℣. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
content.english: ℣. And lead us not into temptation:

segments.t: Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.latin: ℟. Sed líbera nos a malo.
content.english: ℟. But deliver us from evil.

segments.t: Sed líbera nos a malo.

content.latin: Absolutio. A vínculis peccatórum nostrórum absólvat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus.
content.english: Absolution. May the Almighty and merciful Lord loose us from the bonds of our sins.

segments.t: Absolutio.
A vínculis peccatórum nostrórum absólvat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Ille nos benedícat, qui sine fine vivit et regnat.
content.english: Benediction. May His blessing be upon us who doth live and reign for ever.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Ille nos benedícat, qui sine fine vivit et regnat.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: De Isaía Prophéta
content.english: Lesson from the book of Isaias

content.latin: 1 Et factum est in diébus Achaz, fílii Ióatham, fílii Ozíæ, regis Iuda, ascéndit Rasin, rex Sýriæ, et Phácee, fílius Romelíæ, rex Israël, in Ierúsalem, ad præliándum contra eam: et non potuérunt debelláre eam.
content.english: 1 And it came to pass in the days of Achaz the son of Joathan, the son of Ozias, king of Juda, that Basin king of Syria, and Phacee the son of Romelia king of Israel, came up to Jerusalem, to fight against it: but they could not prevail over it.

segments.t: Et factum est in diébus Achaz, fílii Ióatham, fílii Ozíæ, regis Iuda, ascéndit Rasin, rex Sýriæ, et Phácee, fílius Romelíæ, rex Israël, in Ierúsalem, ad præliándum contra eam: et non potuérunt debelláre eam.

content.latin: 2 Et nuntiavérunt dómui David, dicéntes: Requiévit Sýria super Ephraim, et commótum est cor eius, et cor pópuli eius, sicut movéntur ligna silvárum a fácie venti.
content.english: 2 And they told the house of David, saying: Syria hath rested upon Ephraim, and his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the woods are moved with the wind.

segments.t: Et nuntiavérunt dómui David, dicéntes: Requiévit Sýria super Ephraim, et commótum est cor eius, et cor pópuli eius, sicut movéntur ligna silvárum a fácie venti.

content.latin: 3 Et dixit Dóminus ad Isaíam: Egrédere in occúrsum Achaz tu, et qui derelíctus est Iasub fílius tuus, ad extrémum aquædúctus piscínæ superióris in via Agri fullónis.
content.english: 3 And the Lord said to Isaias: Go forth to meet Achaz, thou and Jasub thy son that is left, to the conduit in the upper pool, in the way of the fuller's field.

segments.t: Et dixit Dóminus ad Isaíam: Egrédere in occúrsum Achaz tu, et qui derelíctus est Iasub fílius tuus, ad extrémum aquædúctus piscínæ superióris in via Agri fullónis.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟. Ecce virgo concípiet, et páriet fílium, dicit Dóminus:
content.english: ℟. Behold, the Virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, saith the Lord;

segments.t: Ecce virgo concípiet, et páriet fílium, dicit Dóminus:

content.latin: * Et vocábitur nomen eius Admirábilis, Deus, Fortis.
content.english: * And His name shall be called Wonderful, the Mighty God.

content.latin: ℣. Super sólium David, et super regnum eius sedébit in ætérnum.
content.english: ℣. He shall sit upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom for ever.

segments.t: Super sólium David, et super regnum eius sedébit in ætérnum.

content.latin: ℟. Et vocábitur nomen eius Admirábilis, Deus, Fortis.
content.english: ℟. And His name shall be called Wonderful, the Mighty God.

segments.t: Et vocábitur nomen eius Admirábilis, Deus, Fortis.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Divínum auxílium máneat semper nobíscum.
content.english: Benediction. God's most mighty strength alway be His people's staff and stay.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Divínum auxílium máneat semper nobíscum.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: 4 Et dices ad eum: Vide ut síleas: noli timére, et cor tuum ne formídet a duábus caudis titiónum fumigántium istórum, in ira furóris Rasin, regis Sýriæ, et fílii Romelíæ:
content.english: 4 And thou shalt say to him: See thou be quiet: fear not, and let not thy heart be afraid of the two tails of these fire brands, smoking with the wrath of the fury of Rasin king of Syria, and of the son of Romelia.

segments.t: Et dices ad eum: Vide ut síleas: noli timére, et cor tuum ne formídet a duábus caudis titiónum fumigántium istórum, in ira furóris Rasin, regis Sýriæ, et fílii Romelíæ:

content.latin: 5 Eo quod consílium iníerit contra te Sýria in malum Ephraim, et fílius Romelíæ, dicéntes:
content.english: 5 Because Syria hath taken counsel against thee, unto the evil of Ephraim and the son of Romelia, saying:

segments.t: Eo quod consílium iníerit contra te Sýria in malum Ephraim, et fílius Romelíæ, dicéntes:

content.latin: 6 Ascendámus ad Iudam, et suscitémus eum, et avellámus eum ad nos, et ponámus regem in médio eius fílium Tábeel.
content.english: 6 Let us go up to Juda, and rouse it up, and draw it away to us, and make the son of Tabeel king in the midst thereof.

segments.t: Ascendámus ad Iudam, et suscitémus eum, et avellámus eum ad nos, et ponámus regem in médio eius fílium Tábeel.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟. Audíte verbum Dómini, gentes, et annuntiáte illud in fínibus terræ:
content.english: ℟. Hear the word of the Lord, O ye nations, and declare it in the ends of the earth;

segments.t: Audíte verbum Dómini, gentes, et annuntiáte illud in fínibus terræ:

content.latin: * Et ínsulis, quæ procul sunt, dícite: Salvátor noster advéniet.
content.english: * And in the isles afar off, and say: Our Saviour shall come.

content.latin: ℣. Annuntiáte, et audítum fácite: loquímini, et clamáte.
content.english: ℣. Declare it and make it known, lift up your voice and cry aloud.

segments.t: Annuntiáte, et audítum fácite: loquímini, et clamáte.

content.latin: ℟. Et ínsulis, quæ procul sunt, dícite: Salvátor noster advéniet.
content.english: ℟. And in the isles afar off, and say: Our Saviour shall come.

segments.t: Et ínsulis, quæ procul sunt, dícite: Salvátor noster advéniet.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Ad societátem cívium supernórum perdúcat nos Rex Angelórum.
content.english: Benediction. May He that is the Angels' King to that high realm His people bring.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Ad societátem cívium supernórum perdúcat nos Rex Angelórum.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: 10 Et adiécit Dóminus loqui ad Achaz, dicens:
content.english: 10 And the Lord spoke again to Achaz, saying:

segments.t: Et adiécit Dóminus loqui ad Achaz, dicens:

content.latin: 11 Pete tibi signum a Dómino Deo tuo in profúndum inférni, sive in excélsum supra.
content.english: 11 Ask thee a sign of the Lord thy God either unto the depth of hell, or unto the height above.

segments.t: Pete tibi signum a Dómino Deo tuo in profúndum inférni, sive in excélsum supra.

content.latin: 12 Et dixit Achaz: Non petam, et non tentábo Dóminum.
content.english: 12 And Achaz said: I will not ask, and I will not tempt the Lord.

segments.t: Et dixit Achaz: Non petam, et non tentábo Dóminum.

content.latin: 13 Et dixit: Audíte ergo, domus David: Numquid parum vobis est, moléstos esse homínibus, quia molésti estis et Deo meo?
content.english: 13 And he said: Hear ye therefore, O house of David: Is it a small thing for you to be grievous to men, that you are grievous to my God also?

segments.t: Et dixit: Audíte ergo, domus David: Numquid parum vobis est, moléstos esse homínibus, quia molésti estis et Deo meo?

content.latin: 14 Propter hoc dabit Dóminus ipse vobis signum. Ecce virgo concípiet, et páriet fílium, et vocábitur nomen eius Emmánuel.
content.english: 14 Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign. Behold a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and his name shall be called Emmanuel.

segments.t: Propter hoc dabit Dóminus ipse vobis signum. Ecce virgo concípiet, et páriet fílium, et vocábitur nomen eius Emmánuel.

content.latin: 15 Butýrum et mel cómedet, ut sciat reprobáre malum, et elígere bonum.
content.english: 15 He shall eat butter and honey, that he may know to refuse the evil, and to choose the good.

segments.t: Butýrum et mel cómedet, ut sciat reprobáre malum, et elígere bonum.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟. Ecce dies véniunt, dicit Dóminus, et suscitábo David germen iustum: et regnábit rex, et sápiens erit, et fáciet iudícium et iustítiam in terra:
content.english: ℟. Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch; and a King shall reign in wisdom and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth:

segments.t: Ecce dies véniunt, dicit Dóminus, et suscitábo David germen iustum: et regnábit rex, et sápiens erit, et fáciet iudícium et iustítiam in terra:

content.latin: * Et hoc est nomen quod vocábunt eum: * Dóminus iustus noster.
content.english: * And this is His name whereby He shall be called: * The Lord our Righteous one.

content.latin: ℣. In diébus illis salvábitur Iuda, et Israël habitábit confidénter.
content.english: ℣. In His days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely.

segments.t: In diébus illis salvábitur Iuda, et Israël habitábit confidénter.

content.latin: ℟. Et hoc est nomen quod vocábunt eum:
content.english: ℟. And this is His name whereby He shall be called.

segments.t: Et hoc est nomen quod vocábunt eum:

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Dóminus iustus noster.
content.english: ℟. The Lord our Righteous one.

segments.t: Dóminus iustus noster.

content.latin: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi separandæ sint.
content.english: Skip the rest, unless praying separately.

segments.t: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi separandæ sint.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Excita, quǽsumus, Dómine, poténtiam tuam, et veni: ut ab imminéntibus peccatórum nostrórum perículis, te mereámur protegénte éripi, te liberánte salvári:
content.english: Stir up, O Lord, we pray thee, thy strength, and come among us, that whereas through our sins and wickedness we do justly apprehend thy wrathful judgments hanging over us, thy bountiful grace and mercy may speedily help and deliver us;

content.latin: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Benígne fac, Dómine, * in bona voluntáte tua Sion.
content.english: Ant. In thy good will, O Lord, * deal favourably with Sion.

segments.t: Ant.
Benígne fac, Dómine, * in bona voluntáte tua Sion.

content.latin: Psalmus 50 [1]
content.english: Psalm 50 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 50

content.latin: 50:3 Miserére mei, Deus, * secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.
content.english: 50:3 Have mercy on me, O God, * according to thy great mercy.

segments.t: Miserére mei, Deus, * secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.

content.latin: 50:3 Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, * dele iniquitátem meam.
content.english: 50:3 And according to the multitude of thy tender mercies * blot out my iniquity.

segments.t: Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, * dele iniquitátem meam.

content.latin: 50:4 Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea: * et a peccáto meo munda me.
content.english: 50:4 Wash me yet more from my iniquity, * and cleanse me from my sin.

segments.t: Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea: * et a peccáto meo munda me.

content.latin: 50:5 Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco: * et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
content.english: 50:5 For I know my iniquity, * and my sin is always before me.

segments.t: Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco: * et peccátum meum contra me est semper.

content.latin: 50:6 Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci: * ut iustificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum iudicáris.
content.english: 50:6 To thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before thee: * that thou mayst be justified in thy words, and mayst overcome when thou art judged.

segments.t: Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci: * ut iustificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum iudicáris.

content.latin: 50:7 Ecce enim, in iniquitátibus concéptus sum: * et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
content.english: 50:7 For behold I was conceived in iniquities; * and in sins did my mother conceive me.

segments.t: Ecce enim, in iniquitátibus concéptus sum: * et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.

content.latin: 50:8 Ecce enim, veritátem dilexísti: * incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.
content.english: 50:8 For behold thou hast loved truth: * the uncertain and hidden things of thy wisdom thou hast made manifest to me.

segments.t: Ecce enim, veritátem dilexísti: * incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.

content.latin: 50:9 Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor: * lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
content.english: 50:9 Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: * thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

segments.t: Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor: * lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.

content.latin: 50:10 Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam: * et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
content.english: 50:10 To my hearing thou shalt give joy and gladness: * and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

segments.t: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam: * et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.

content.latin: 50:11 Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis: * et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
content.english: 50:11 Turn away thy face from my sins, * and blot out all my iniquities.

segments.t: Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis: * et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.

content.latin: 50:12 Cor mundum crea in me, Deus: * et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
content.english: 50:12 Create a clean heart in me, O God: * and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

segments.t: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus: * et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.

content.latin: 50:13 Ne proícias me a fácie tua: * et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
content.english: 50:13 Cast me not away from thy face; * and take not thy holy spirit from me.

segments.t: Ne proícias me a fácie tua: * et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.

content.latin: 50:14 Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui: * et spíritu principáli confírma me.
content.english: 50:14 Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation, * and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

segments.t: Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui: * et spíritu principáli confírma me.

content.latin: 50:15 Docébo iníquos vias tuas: * et ímpii ad te converténtur.
content.english: 50:15 I will teach the unjust thy ways: * and the wicked shall be converted to thee.

segments.t: Docébo iníquos vias tuas: * et ímpii ad te converténtur.

content.latin: 50:16 Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ: * et exsultábit lingua mea iustítiam tuam.
content.english: 50:16 Deliver me from blood, O God, thou God of my salvation: * and my tongue shall extol thy justice.

segments.t: Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ: * et exsultábit lingua mea iustítiam tuam.

content.latin: 50:17 Dómine, lábia mea apéries: * et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
content.english: 50:17 O Lord, thou wilt open my lips: * and my mouth shall declare thy praise.

segments.t: Dómine, lábia mea apéries: * et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.

content.latin: 50:18 Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique: * holocáustis non delectáberis.
content.english: 50:18 For if thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: * with burnt offerings thou wilt not be delighted.

segments.t: Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique: * holocáustis non delectáberis.

content.latin: 50:19 Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus: * cor contrítum, et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
content.english: 50:19 A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: * a contrite and humbled heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

segments.t: Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus: * cor contrítum, et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.

content.latin: 50:20 Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion: * ut ædificéntur muri Ierúsalem.
content.english: 50:20 Deal favourably, O Lord, in thy good will with Sion; * that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

segments.t: Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion: * ut ædificéntur muri Ierúsalem.

content.latin: 50:21 Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium iustítiæ, oblatiónes, et holocáusta: * tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
content.english: 50:21 Then shalt thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations and whole burnt offerings: * then shall they lay calves upon thy altar.

segments.t: Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium iustítiæ, oblatiónes, et holocáusta: * tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion.
content.english: Ant. In thy good will, O Lord, deal favourably with Sion.

segments.t: Ant.
Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion.

content.latin: Ant. Rectus Dóminus, * Deus noster, et non est iníquitas in eo.
content.english: Ant. The Lord our God is righteous * and there is no iniquity in him.

segments.t: Ant.
Rectus Dóminus, * Deus noster, et non est iníquitas in eo.

content.latin: Psalmus 91 [2]
content.english: Psalm 91 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 91

content.latin: 91:2 Bonum est confitéri Dómino: * et psállere nómini tuo, Altíssime.
content.english: 91:2 It is good to give praise to the Lord: * and to sing to thy name, O most High.

segments.t: Bonum est confitéri Dómino: * et psállere nómini tuo, Altíssime.

content.latin: 91:3 Ad annuntiándum mane misericórdiam tuam: * et veritátem tuam per noctem.
content.english: 91:3 To shew forth thy mercy in the morning, * and thy truth in the night:

segments.t: Ad annuntiándum mane misericórdiam tuam: * et veritátem tuam per noctem.

content.latin: 91:4 In decachórdo, psaltério: * cum cántico, in cíthara.
content.english: 91:4 Upon an instrument of ten strings, upon the psaltery: * with a canticle upon the harp.

segments.t: In decachórdo, psaltério: * cum cántico, in cíthara.

content.latin: 91:5 Quia delectásti me, Dómine, in factúra tua: * et in opéribus mánuum tuárum exsultábo.
content.english: 91:5 For thou hast given me, O Lord, a delight in thy doings: * and in the works of thy hands I shall rejoice.

segments.t: Quia delectásti me, Dómine, in factúra tua: * et in opéribus mánuum tuárum exsultábo.

content.latin: 91:6 Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! * nimis profúndæ factæ sunt cogitatiónes tuæ.
content.english: 91:6 O Lord, how great are thy works! * thy thoughts are exceeding deep.

segments.t: Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! * nimis profúndæ factæ sunt cogitatiónes tuæ.

content.latin: 91:7 Vir insípiens non cognóscet: * et stultus non intélleget hæc.
content.english: 91:7 The senseless man shall not know: * nor will the fool understand these things.

segments.t: Vir insípiens non cognóscet: * et stultus non intélleget hæc.

content.latin: 91:8 Cum exórti fúerint peccatóres sicut fænum: * et apparúerint omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem:
content.english: 91:8 When the wicked shall spring up as grass: * and all the workers of iniquity shall appear:

segments.t: Cum exórti fúerint peccatóres sicut fænum: * et apparúerint omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem:

content.latin: 91:9 Ut intéreant in sǽculum sǽculi: * tu autem Altíssimus in ætérnum, Dómine.
content.english: 91:9 That they may perish for ever and ever: * but thou, O Lord, art most high for evermore.

segments.t: Ut intéreant in sǽculum sǽculi: * tu autem Altíssimus in ætérnum, Dómine.

content.latin: 91:10 Quóniam ecce inimíci tui, Dómine, quóniam ecce inimíci tui períbunt: * et dispergéntur omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem.
content.english: 91:10 For behold thy enemies, O Lord, for behold thy enemies shall perish: * and all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

segments.t: Quóniam ecce inimíci tui, Dómine, quóniam ecce inimíci tui períbunt: * et dispergéntur omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem.

content.latin: 91:11 Et exaltábitur sicut unicórnis cornu meum: * et senéctus mea in misericórdia úberi.
content.english: 91:11 But my horn shall be exalted like that of the unicorn: * and my old age in plentiful mercy.

segments.t: Et exaltábitur sicut unicórnis cornu meum: * et senéctus mea in misericórdia úberi.

content.latin: 91:12 Et despéxit óculus meus inimícos meos: * et in insurgéntibus in me malignántibus áudiet auris mea.
content.english: 91:12 My eye also hath looked down upon my enemies: * and my ear shall hear of the downfall of the malignant that rise up against me.

segments.t: Et despéxit óculus meus inimícos meos: * et in insurgéntibus in me malignántibus áudiet auris mea.

content.latin: 91:13 Iustus, ut palma florébit: * sicut cedrus Líbani multiplicábitur.
content.english: 91:13 The just shall flourish like the palm tree: * he shall grow up like the cedar of Libanus.

segments.t: Iustus, ut palma florébit: * sicut cedrus Líbani multiplicábitur.

content.latin: 91:14 Plantáti in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri florébunt.
content.english: 91:14 They that are planted in the house of the Lord * shall flourish in the courts of the house of our God.

segments.t: Plantáti in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri florébunt.

content.latin: 91:15 Adhuc multiplicabúntur in senécta úberi: * et bene patiéntes erunt, ut annúntient:
content.english: 91:15 They shall still increase in a fruitful old age: * and shall be well treated, that they may shew,

segments.t: Adhuc multiplicabúntur in senécta úberi: * et bene patiéntes erunt, ut annúntient:

content.latin: 91:16 Quóniam rectus Dóminus, Deus noster: * et non est iníquitas in eo.
content.english: 91:16 That the Lord our God is righteous, * and there is no iniquity in him.

segments.t: Quóniam rectus Dóminus, Deus noster: * et non est iníquitas in eo.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Rectus Dóminus, Deus noster, et non est iníquitas in eo.
content.english: Ant. The Lord our God is righteous and there is no iniquity in him.

segments.t: Ant.
Rectus Dóminus, Deus noster, et non est iníquitas in eo.

content.latin: Ant. A timóre inimíci * éripe, Dómine, ánimam meam.
content.english: Ant. Deliver my soul, * O Lord, from the fear of the enemy.

segments.t: Ant.
A timóre inimíci * éripe, Dómine, ánimam meam.

content.latin: Psalmus 63 [3]
content.english: Psalm 63 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 63

content.latin: 63:2 Exáudi, Deus, oratiónem meam cum déprecor: * a timóre inimíci éripe ánimam meam.
content.english: 63:2 Hear, O God, my prayer, when I make supplication to thee: * deliver my soul from the fear of the enemy.

segments.t: Exáudi, Deus, oratiónem meam cum déprecor: * a timóre inimíci éripe ánimam meam.

content.latin: 63:3 Protexísti me a convéntu malignántium: * a multitúdine operántium iniquitátem.
content.english: 63:3 Thou hast protected me from the assembly of the malignant; * from the multitude of the workers of iniquity.

segments.t: Protexísti me a convéntu malignántium: * a multitúdine operántium iniquitátem.

content.latin: 63:4 Quia exacuérunt ut gládium linguas suas: * intendérunt arcum rem amáram, ut sagíttent in occúltis immaculátum.
content.english: 63:4 For they have whetted their tongues like a sword; * they have bent their bow a bitter thing, to shoot in secret the undefiled.

segments.t: Quia exacuérunt ut gládium linguas suas: * intendérunt arcum rem amáram, ut sagíttent in occúltis immaculátum.

content.latin: 63:6 Súbito sagittábunt eum, et non timébunt: * firmavérunt sibi sermónem nequam.
content.english: 63:6 They will shoot at him on a sudden, and will not fear: * they are resolute in wickedness.

segments.t: Súbito sagittábunt eum, et non timébunt: * firmavérunt sibi sermónem nequam.

content.latin: 63:6 Narravérunt ut abscónderent láqueos: * dixérunt: Quis vidébit eos?
content.english: 63:6 They have talked of hiding snares; * they have said: Who shall see them?

segments.t: Narravérunt ut abscónderent láqueos: * dixérunt: Quis vidébit eos?

content.latin: 63:7 Scrutáti sunt iniquitátes: * defecérunt scrutántes scrutínio.
content.english: 63:7 They have searched after iniquities: * they have failed in their search.

segments.t: Scrutáti sunt iniquitátes: * defecérunt scrutántes scrutínio.

content.latin: 63:7 Accédet homo ad cor altum: * et exaltábitur Deus.
content.english: 63:7 Man shall come to a deep heart: * and God shall be exalted.

segments.t: Accédet homo ad cor altum: * et exaltábitur Deus.

content.latin: 63:8 Sagíttæ parvulórum factæ sunt plagæ eórum: * et infirmátæ sunt contra eos linguæ eórum.
content.english: 63:8 The arrows of children are their wounds: * and their tongues against them are made weak.

segments.t: Sagíttæ parvulórum factæ sunt plagæ eórum: * et infirmátæ sunt contra eos linguæ eórum.

content.latin: 63:9 Conturbáti sunt omnes qui vidébant eos: * et tímuit omnis homo.
content.english: 63:9 All that saw them were troubled; * and every man was afraid.

segments.t: Conturbáti sunt omnes qui vidébant eos: * et tímuit omnis homo.

content.latin: 63:10 Et annuntiavérunt ópera Dei, * et facta eius intellexérunt.
content.english: 63:10 And they declared the works of God: * and understood his doings.

segments.t: Et annuntiavérunt ópera Dei, * et facta eius intellexérunt.

content.latin: 63:11 Lætábitur iustus in Dómino, et sperábit in eo, * et laudabúntur omnes recti corde.
content.english: 63:11 The just shall rejoice in the Lord, and shall hope in him: * and all the upright in heart shall be praised.

segments.t: Lætábitur iustus in Dómino, et sperábit in eo, * et laudabúntur omnes recti corde.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. A timóre inimíci éripe, Dómine, ánimam meam.
content.english: Ant. Deliver my soul, O Lord, from the fear of the enemy.

A timóre inimíci éripe, Dómine, ánimam meam.

content.english: Ant. The Lord will judge * his servants, and will have mercy on the people of his land.

In servis suis * miserébitur Dóminus et propítius erit terræ pópuli sui.

content.english: Canticle of Moses [4]

segments.t: Canticum Moysis

content.latin: 32:1 Audíte, cæli, quæ loquor: * áudiat terra verba oris mei.
content.english: 32:1 Hear, O ye heavens, the things I speak, * let the earth give ear to the words of my mouth.

segments.t: Audíte, cæli, quæ loquor: * áudiat terra verba oris mei.

content.latin: 32:2 Concréscat ut plúvia doctrína mea, * fluat ut ros elóquium meum.
content.english: 32:2 Let my doctrine gather as the rain, * let my speech distill as the dew,

segments.t: Concréscat ut plúvia doctrína mea, * fluat ut ros elóquium meum.

content.latin: 32:3 Quasi imber super herbam, et quasi stillæ super grámina. * Quia nomen Dómini invocábo.
content.english: 32:3 As a shower upon the herb, and as drops upon the grass. * Because I will invoke the name of the Lord:

segments.t: Quasi imber super herbam, et quasi stillæ super grámina. * Quia nomen Dómini invocábo.

content.latin: 32:4 Date magnificéntiam Deo nostro. * Dei perfécta sunt ópera, et omnes viæ eius iudícia:
content.english: 32:4 Give ye magnificence to our God. * The works of God are perfect, and all his ways are judgments:

segments.t: Date magnificéntiam Deo nostro. * Dei perfécta sunt ópera, et omnes viæ eius iudícia:

content.latin: 32:5 Deus fidélis, et absque ulla iniquitáte, iustus et rectus. * Peccavérunt ei, et non fílii eius in sórdibus:
content.english: 32:5 God is faithful and without any iniquity, he is just and right. * They have sinned against him, and are none of his children in their filth:

segments.t: Deus fidélis, et absque ulla iniquitáte, iustus et rectus. * Peccavérunt ei, et non fílii eius in sórdibus:

content.latin: 32:6 Generátio prava atque pervérsa. * Hǽccine reddis Dómino, pópule stulte et insípiens?
content.english: 32:6 They are a wicked and perverse generation. * Is this the return thou makest to the Lord, O foolish and senseless people?

segments.t: Generátio prava atque pervérsa. * Hǽccine reddis Dómino, pópule stulte et insípiens?

content.latin: 32:7 Numquid non ipse est pater tuus, * qui possédit te, et fecit, et creávit te?
content.english: 32:7 Is not he thy father, * that hath possessed thee, and made thee, and created thee?

segments.t: Numquid non ipse est pater tuus, * qui possédit te, et fecit, et creávit te?

content.latin: 32:8 Meménto diérum antiquórum, * cógita generatiónes síngulas:
content.english: 32:8 Remember the days of old, * think upon every generation:

segments.t: Meménto diérum antiquórum, * cógita generatiónes síngulas:

content.latin: 32:9 Intérroga patrem tuum, et annuntiábit tibi: * maióres tuos, et dicent tibi.
content.english: 32:9 Ask thy father, and he will declare to thee: * thy elders and they will tell thee.

segments.t: Intérroga patrem tuum, et annuntiábit tibi: * maióres tuos, et dicent tibi.

content.latin: 32:10 Quando dividébat Altíssimus gentes: * quando separábat fílios Adam.
content.english: 32:10 When the Most High divided the nations: * when he separated the sons of Adam,

segments.t: Quando dividébat Altíssimus gentes: * quando separábat fílios Adam.

content.latin: 32:11 Constítuit términos populórum * iuxta númerum filiórum Israël.
content.english: 32:11 He appointed the bounds of people * according to the number of the children of Israel.

segments.t: Constítuit términos populórum * iuxta númerum filiórum Israël.

content.latin: 32:12 Pars autem Dómini, pópulus eius: * Iacob funículus hereditátis eius.
content.english: 32:12 But the Lord’s portion is his people: * Jacob the lot of his inheritance.

segments.t: Pars autem Dómini, pópulus eius: * Iacob funículus hereditátis eius.

content.latin: 32:13 Invénit eum in terra desérta, * in loco horróris et vastæ solitúdinis:
content.english: 32:13 He found him in a desert land, * in a place of horror, and of vast wilderness:

segments.t: Invénit eum in terra desérta, * in loco horróris et vastæ solitúdinis:

content.latin: 32:14 Circumdúxit eum, et dócuit: * et custodívit quasi pupíllam óculi sui.
content.english: 32:14 He led him about, and taught him: * and he kept him as the apple of his eye.

segments.t: Circumdúxit eum, et dócuit: * et custodívit quasi pupíllam óculi sui.

content.latin: 32:15 Sicut áquila próvocans ad volándum pullos suos, * et super eos vólitans,
content.english: 32:15 As the eagle enticing her young to fly, * and hovering over them,

segments.t: Sicut áquila próvocans ad volándum pullos suos, * et super eos vólitans,

content.latin: 32:16 Expándit alas suas, et assúmpsit eum, * atque portávit in húmeris suis.
content.english: 32:16 He spread his wings, and hath taken him * and carried him on his shoulders.

segments.t: Expándit alas suas, et assúmpsit eum, * atque portávit in húmeris suis.

content.latin: 32:17 Dóminus solus dux eius fuit: * et non erat cum eo deus aliénus.
content.english: 32:17 The Lord alone was his leader: * and there was no strange god with him.

segments.t: Dóminus solus dux eius fuit: * et non erat cum eo deus aliénus.

content.latin: 32:18 Constítuit eum super excélsam terram: * ut coméderet fructus agrórum,
content.english: 32:18 He set him upon high land: * that he might eat the fruits of the fields,

segments.t: Constítuit eum super excélsam terram: * ut coméderet fructus agrórum,

content.latin: 32:19 Ut súgeret mel de petra, * oleúmque de saxo duríssimo.
content.english: 32:19 That he might suck honey out of the rock, * and oil out of the hardest stone,

segments.t: Ut súgeret mel de petra, * oleúmque de saxo duríssimo.

content.latin: 32:20 Butýrum de arménto, et lac de óvibus * cum ádipe agnórum, et aríetum filiórum Basan:
content.english: 32:20 Butter of the herd, and milk of the sheep * with the fat of lambs, and of the rams of the breed of Basan:

segments.t: Butýrum de arménto, et lac de óvibus * cum ádipe agnórum, et aríetum filiórum Basan:

content.latin: 32:21 Et hircos cum medúlla trítici, * et sánguinem uvæ bíberet meracíssimum.
content.english: 32:21 And goats with the marrow of wheat, * and might drink the purest blood of the grape.

segments.t: Et hircos cum medúlla trítici, * et sánguinem uvæ bíberet meracíssimum.

content.latin: 32:22 Incrassátus est diléctus, et recalcitrávit: * incrassátus, impinguátus, dilatátus,
content.english: 32:22 The beloved grew fat, and kicked: * he grew fat, and thick and gross,

segments.t: Incrassátus est diléctus, et recalcitrávit: * incrassátus, impinguátus, dilatátus,

content.latin: 32:23 Derelíquit Deum, factórem suum, * et recéssit a Deo, salutári suo.
content.english: 32:23 He forsook God who made him, * and departed from God his saviour.

segments.t: Derelíquit Deum, factórem suum, * et recéssit a Deo, salutári suo.

content.latin: 32:24 Provocavérunt eum in diis aliénis, * et in abominatiónibus ad iracúndiam concitavérunt.
content.english: 32:24 They provoked him by strange gods, * and stirred him up to anger, with their abominations.

segments.t: Provocavérunt eum in diis aliénis, * et in abominatiónibus ad iracúndiam concitavérunt.

content.latin: 32:25 Immolavérunt dæmóniis, et non Deo, * diis, quos ignorábant:
content.english: 32:25 They sacrificed to devils and not to God: * to gods whom they knew not:

segments.t: Immolavérunt dæmóniis, et non Deo, * diis, quos ignorábant:

content.latin: 32:26 Novi recentésque venérunt, * quos non coluérunt patres eórum.
content.english: 32:26 That were newly come up, * whom their fathers worshipped not.

segments.t: Novi recentésque venérunt, * quos non coluérunt patres eórum.

content.latin: 32:27 Deum qui te génuit dereliquísti, * et oblítus es Dómini, creatóris tui.
content.english: 32:27 Thou hast forsaken the God that beget * and hast forgotten the Lord that created thee.

segments.t: Deum qui te génuit dereliquísti, * et oblítus es Dómini, creatóris tui.

content.latin: 150:1 Laudáte Dóminum in sanctis eius: * laudáte eum in firmaménto virtútis eius.
content.english: 150:1 Praise ye the Lord in his holy places: * praise ye him in the firmament of his power.

segments.t: Laudáte Dóminum in sanctis eius: * laudáte eum in firmaménto virtútis eius.

content.latin: 150:2 Laudáte eum in virtútibus eius: * laudáte eum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis eius.
content.english: 150:2 Praise ye him for his mighty acts: * praise ye him according to the multitude of his greatness.

segments.t: Laudáte eum in virtútibus eius: * laudáte eum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis eius.

content.latin: 150:3 Laudáte eum in sono tubæ: * laudáte eum in psaltério, et cíthara.
content.english: 150:3 Praise him with sound of trumpet: * praise him with psaltery and harp.

segments.t: Laudáte eum in sono tubæ: * laudáte eum in psaltério, et cíthara.

content.latin: 150:4 Laudáte eum in týmpano, et choro: * laudáte eum in chordis, et órgano.
content.english: 150:4 Praise him with timbrel and choir: * praise him with strings and organs.

segments.t: Laudáte eum in týmpano, et choro: * laudáte eum in chordis, et órgano.

content.latin: 150:5 Laudáte eum in cýmbalis benesonántibus: laudáte eum in cýmbalis iubilatiónis: * omnis spíritus laudet Dóminum.
content.english: 150:5 Praise him on high sounding cymbals: praise him on cymbals of joy: * let every spirit praise the Lord.

segments.t: Laudáte eum in cýmbalis benesonántibus: laudáte eum in cýmbalis iubilatiónis: * omnis spíritus laudet Dóminum.

content.latin: Veníte, et ascendámus ad montem Dómini, et ad domum Dei Iacob, et docébit nos vias suas, et ambulábimus in sémitis eius: quia de Sion exíbit lex, et verbum Dómini de Ierúsalem.
content.english: Come and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob, and he will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall come forth from Sion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

content.latin: Hymnus
content.english: Hymn

segments.t: Hymnus

content.latin: En clara vox redárguit
content.english: Hark, a herald voice is calling;

content.latin: Obscúra quæque, pérsonans:
content.english: “Christ is nigh,” it seems to say;

content.latin: Procul fugéntur sómnia,
content.english: “Cast away the dreams of darkness,

content.latin: Ab alto Iesus prómicat.
content.english: O ye children of the day.”

content.latin: Mens iam resúrgat, tórpida,
content.english: Startled at the solemn warning,

content.latin: Non ámplius iacens humi:
content.english: Let the earth-bound soul arise;

content.latin: Sidus refúlget iam novum,
content.english: Christ, her sun, all sloth dispelling,

content.latin: Ut tollat omne nóxium.
content.english: Shines upon the morning skies.

content.latin: En Agnus ad nos míttitur
content.english: Lo, the Lamb, so long expected,

content.latin: Laxáre gratis débitum:
content.english: Comes with pardon down from heaven;

content.latin: Omnes simul cum lácrimis
content.english: Let us haste, with tears of sorrow,

content.latin: Precémur indulgéntiam.
content.english: One and all to be forgiven.

content.latin: Ut cum secúndo fúlserit,
content.english: So when next he comes with glory,

content.latin: Metúque mundum cínxerit,
content.english: Wrapping all the earth in fear,

content.latin: Non pro reátu púniat,
content.english: May he then as our defender

content.latin: Sed nos pius tunc prótegat.
content.english: On the clouds of heaven appear.

content.latin: Virtus, honor, laus, glória
content.english: Honour, glory, virtue, merit,

content.latin: Deo Patri cum Fílio,
content.english: To the Father and the Son,

content.latin: Sancto simul Paráclito,
content.english: With the co-eternal Spirit,

content.latin: In sæculórum sǽcula.
content.english: While eternal ages run.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.english: ℣. A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

segments.t: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.

content.english: ℟. Make straight his paths.

content.latin: 1:68 Benedíctus ✠ Dóminus, Deus Israël: * quia visitávit, et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:
content.english: 1:68 Blessed be the Lord ✠ God of Israel; * because he hath visited and wrought the redemption of his people:

segments.t: Benedíctus ✠ Dóminus, Deus Israël: * quia visitávit, et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:

content.latin: 1:69 Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.
content.english: 1:69 And hath raised up an horn of salvation to us, * in the house of David his servant:

segments.t: Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.

content.latin: 1:70 Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:
content.english: 1:70 As he spoke by the mouth of his holy Prophets, * who are from the beginning:

segments.t: Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:

content.latin: 1:71 Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.
content.english: 1:71 Salvation from our enemies, * and from the hand of all that hate us:

segments.t: Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.

content.latin: 1:72 Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
content.english: 1:72 To perform mercy to our fathers, * and to remember his holy testament,

segments.t: Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.

content.latin: 1:73 Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:
content.english: 1:73 The oath, which he swore to Abraham our father, * that he would grant to us,

segments.t: Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:

content.latin: 1:74 Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.
content.english: 1:74 That being delivered from the hand of our enemies, * we may serve him without fear,

segments.t: Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.

content.latin: 1:75 In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.
content.english: 1:75 In holiness and justice before him, * all our days.

segments.t: In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.

content.latin: 1:76 Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:
content.english: 1:76 And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: * for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways:

segments.t: Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:

content.latin: 1:77 Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:
content.english: 1:77 To give knowledge of salvation to his people, * unto the remission of their sins:

segments.t: Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:

content.latin: 1:78 Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:
content.english: 1:78 Through the bowels of the mercy of our God, * in which the Orient from on high hath visited us:

segments.t: Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:

content.latin: 1:79 Illumináre his, qui in ténebris, et in umbra mortis sedent: * ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
content.english: 1:79 To enlighten them that sit in darkness, and in the shadow of death: * to direct our feet into the way of peace.

segments.t: Illumináre his, qui in ténebris, et in umbra mortis sedent: * ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
